title: refactor(app-shell): collapse the metadata-admin designer table's byte-identical key pairs
body:
Fixes #4387

After #4377 converged five designer i18n values on the typographic ellipsis `…`, three keys in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` held values byte-identical to a sibling key in **both** the `en` and the `zh` block. The `Dots` suffix used to name "the spelling *with* trailing dots"; both spellings now end in `…`, so the suffix named a distinction that had stopped existing — and one key had no consumer at all.

Per the ruling on #4387: the pairs collapse onto the surviving key and the consumer-less key is deleted.

## Premise verification (re-run at this branch point, `d2f6e6b1b`)

Byte-identity measured on the UTF-8 bytes of each value, not by eye:

| pair | `en` | `zh` | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| `engine.form.select` vs `.selectEllipsis` | `53656c656374e280a6` vs `53656c656374e280a6` | `e8afb7e98089e68ba9e280a6` vs same | identical |
| `engine.form.selectObjectDots` vs `.selectObject` | `53656c656374206f626a656374e280a6` vs same | `e98089e68ba9e5afb9e8b1a1e280a6` vs same | identical |
| `engine.form.selectFieldDots` vs `.selectField` | `53656c656374206669656c64e280a6` vs same | `e98089e68ba9e5ad97e6aeb5e280a6` vs same | identical |

Consumer classification, word-boundary-aware (`engine\.form\.KEY($|[^A-Za-z0-9_])` — a plain substring grep for `engine.form.select` also matches `.selectObjectDots`, `.selectObjectFirst`, `.selectComponent`):

| key | definitions | call sites | disposition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `engine.form.select` | i18n.ts:911, :2685 | **none** | deleted |
| `engine.form.selectEllipsis` | i18n.ts:912, :2686 | SchemaForm.tsx:1209, :1237, widgets.tsx:1028, :1231 | survives |
| `engine.form.selectObjectDots` | i18n.ts:925, :2699 | widgets.tsx:396 | deleted, call site re-pointed |
| `engine.form.selectObject` | i18n.ts:922, :2696 | widgets.tsx:184 | survives |
| `engine.form.selectFieldDots` | i18n.ts:930, :2704 | widgets.tsx:527 | deleted, call site re-pointed |
| `engine.form.selectField` | i18n.ts:929, :2703 | widgets.tsx:960 | survives |

All three premises held. The only non-definition mention of `engine.form.select` anywhere in the repo was prose inside #4377's own changeset.

## Survivor choice

- **`selectObjectDots` → `selectObject`, `selectFieldDots` → `selectField`.** Both members of each pair are live, so consumption does not decide it; the name does. `Dots` described a *spelling* that no longer differs from its sibling's, while `selectObject` / `selectField` describe what the placeholder is for. Reading the two call sites confirms they are the same placeholder reached by two paths: widgets.tsx:396 and :184 are both the single-select object picker's `SelectValue`, and :527 and :960 both the field picker's. Keeping `Dots` would preserve a name that asserts a difference the values no longer have.
- **`engine.form.select` deleted, `selectEllipsis` survives.** Here consumption decides: `select` has zero call sites and `selectEllipsis` has four, so deleting the live one would mean moving four call sites to gain nothing. Noted but deliberately not done: `Ellipsis` is now nearly as uninformative as `Dots` was, since every placeholder in this table ends in `…`. That is a rename of a live key across four call sites, outside this card's collapse-and-delete scope — flagged here rather than smuggled in.

## Zero-rendered-change proof

The collapsed values were byte-identical, so no rendered string moves. Held up by the package's own suite (145 files / 1514 tests green, including the widget render tests that exercise these pickers) plus a new pin test — nothing previously asserted these two placeholders from the rendered side.

`t()` is `pickTable(locale).strings[key] ?? key`, so a miss **echoes the raw key onto the screen** rather than rendering blank or falling back to English. That is what makes the call-site re-point load-bearing, and what the new test catches.

## Reverse verification (direction predicted before running)

Predicted: re-pointing a call site back at its deleted key turns exactly the matching case red, with the literal key text in the DOM — not a blank, not an English fallback — while the other two cases stay green.

Confirmed twice, once per collapsed pair (fix removed with `git checkout HEAD -- `, never `git stash`):

```text
widgets.tsx:396 -> engine.form.selectObjectDots
  TestingLibraryElementError: Unable to find an element with the text: Select object…
  DOM: engine.form.selectObjectDots
  Tests  1 failed | 2 passed (3)

widgets.tsx:527 -> engine.form.selectFieldDots
  TestingLibraryElementError: Unable to find an element with the text: Select field…
  DOM: engine.form.selectFieldDots
  Tests  1 failed | 2 passed (3)
```

Restored, tree clean, both re-runs green.

## Verification

| command | result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ --maxWorkers=2` | `Test Files 145 passed (145)` · `Tests 1514 passed \| 1 skipped (1515)` |
| `tsc --noEmit` (app-shell) | exit 0 |
| `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` (app-shell) | exit 0 — caught two missing required props on the new test's `fieldSpec` / `schema`; fixed before push |
| `pnpm exec eslint` on the three touched files | exit 0, 0 errors (33 pre-existing warnings on untouched lines) |
| `pnpm check:i18n-keys` | exit 0 — every in-scope call-site key resolves against the en pack |
| `pnpm check:i18n-drift` | exit 0 — 0 en values changed |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` + `grep -naP` self-scan | clean |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` / `changeset:check` | 2 source files of 1 released package, 1 changeset, no `major` |

Changeset: `patch` for `@object-ui/app-shell`. Rendered output is unchanged and both tables are module-private `const`s, so an empty-frontmatter declaration would also have been defensible; `patch` was chosen so the key-identity change appears in the CHANGELOG for the next author of this module.

The file's header note enumerates no keys — it holds #4377's ellipsis convention — so it is left intact.
